description: Judge calibration and transport check; not a repository-readiness score.

criteria.prompt: The workspace contains a non-empty readable scope-smoke.txt report.
scope-smoke.txt identifies Bun as the package manager and cites package.json; verify the packageManager field.
scope-smoke.txt correctly describes Hono on Cloudflare Workers, using D1 and R2, citing README.md and/or packages/api/package.json.
scope-smoke.txt locates shared React screens in packages/app and distinguishes the app-web and app-capacitor web/native shells with source citations.

tasks.prompt: Inspect README.md, package.json and packages/api/package.json. Write scope-smoke.txt naming the package manager, API framework/runtime/storage, and shared versus web/native app packages. Cite source files. Read only repository files; write only scope-smoke.txt. Do not install, execute code, commit, deploy, access credentials or external services.
